# Setup
```{r}
#| label: setup

project_dir <- "C:/Users/swang01/OneDrive - The Institute of Cancer Research/Desktop/PM and FBC"
input_file <- file.path(project_dir, "Meta-analysis.xlsx")
figure_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "Figures")
table_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "Tables")

dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

library("metafor")
library("dplyr")
library("tidyr")
library("ggplot2")
library("forestplot")
library("readxl")
library("svglite")

```

# Part I. Overall meta-analysis for PM10
## PM10 initial meta-analysis with all studies (17 studies)
```{r}
#| label: PM10 initial meta-analysis with all studies (17 studies)
#| out-width: "90%"
#| echo: false

data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = "PM10-All")

###Standardise the effect estimates (per 10 µg/m3 increase)
data$logHR <- log(data$Effect)
data$SE <- (log(data$Upper_CI) - log(data$Lower_CI)) / (2 * 1.96)
data$logHR_10 <- data$logHR * (10 / data$Unit_increase)
data$SE_10 <- data$SE * (10 / data$Unit_increase)
data$HR_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10)
data$LowerCI_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10 - 1.96 * data$SE_10)
data$UpperCI_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10 + 1.96 * data$SE_10)

PM10_res <- rma(yi = logHR_10,sei = SE_10,data = data,method = "DL",slab = data$Study)
data$weights <- weights(PM10_res)  #Extract weights
data_sorted <- data[order(-data$weights),]  #Sort data by descending weight
PM10_res_sorted <- rma(yi = logHR_10, sei = SE_10, data = data_sorted, method = "DL", slab = data_sorted$Study)  #Re-run meta-analysis with sorted data
PM10_res <- PM10_res_sorted

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("p < 0.001")
  } else {
    return(paste0("p = ", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3)))
  }
}

svglite(file = file.path(figure_dir, "PM10All.svg"),width = 6,height = 9)
forest(PM10_res, at = log(c(0.5,1,1.5,2)), atransf = exp, header = c("Study","HR [95%CI]"), showweights = TRUE,
       xlab = "Hazard Ratio", mlab = paste0("Random effect model\nHeterogeneity: I² = ", round(PM10_res$I2, 2),"%, ",format_p(PM10_res$QEp)),
       xlim = c(-2.45,2),ylim = c(-3,length(PM10_res$yi)+3),lwd = 1.5, col = "maroon",border = "maroon",pch = 16, width = 2 ,shade = TRUE, colshade = "#EBEBEB",
       cex = 0.8, efac = 0.5)
text(x = 0.9,y = length(PM10_res$yi) + 2,labels = "Weight",font = 2, cex = 0.8)
invisible(dev.off())

###Based on the created figure, Smotherman, 2023's study looks like an influential study.
###therefore, conduct the leave-one-out analysis to confirm
loo_df <- as.data.frame(leave1out(PM10_res))
loo_df$HR <- round(exp(loo_df$estimate), 2)
loo_df$CI <- paste0("(", round(exp(loo_df$ci.lb), 2), ", ", round(exp(loo_df$ci.ub), 2), ")")
loo_df$HR_95CI <- paste0(loo_df$HR,loo_df$CI)
loo_df$I2_new <- paste0(round(loo_df$I2,2),"%")
loo_df$P_value <- ifelse(loo_df$pval<0.001,"<0.001",loo_df$pval)
loo_df$Heterogeneity_Pvalue <- ifelse(loo_df$Qp<0.001,"<0.001",loo_df$Qp)
write.csv(loo_df,file = file.path(table_dir, "PM10InitialLOO.csv"))
###After excluding Smotherman, 2023's study, I2 changes from 86.69% to 35.99%, HR changes from 1.10 to 1.03
###So, for the main analysis, excluded this study (PM10-Main)

knitr::include_graphics("Figures/PM10All.svg")
knitr::kable(loo_df,caption = "Leave-one-out sensitivity analysis of intial all studies for PM10",digits = 2,row.names = TRUE)
```

## Supplemetary figure 3A. PM10 Funnel plot and Egger’s test
```{r}
#| label: Supplemetary figure 3A. PM10 Funnel plot and Egger’s test
#| out-width: "90%"
#| echo: false

egger_test <- regtest(PM10_res, model = "rma", predictor = "sei")
print(egger_test)

svglite(file = file.path(figure_dir, "PM10Funnelplot.svg"),width = 6,height = 9)
funnel(PM10_res,atransf = exp, at = log(c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2)),ylim = c(0,0.35),yaxt = "n",xlab = "Hazard Ratio", ylab = "Standard Error")
axis(2, at = seq(0, 0.35, by = 0.05), las = 1)
text(x = log(0.45), y = 0.35, pos = 4,labels = paste0("Egger's test: z = ", round(egger_test$zval, 2),", p = ", signif(egger_test$pval, 3)),cex = 0.9)
invisible(dev.off())

knitr::include_graphics("Figures/PM10Funnelplot.svg")
```

# Part II. Overall meta-analysis for PM2.5
## PM2.5 initial meta-analysis with all studies (28 studies)
```{r}

#| out-width: "90%"
#| echo: false

###Standardise the effect estimates (per 10 µg/m3 increase)
data$logHR <- log(data$Effect)
data$SE <- (log(data$Upper_CI) - log(data$Lower_CI)) / (2 * 1.96)
data$logHR_10 <- data$logHR * (10 / data$Unit_increase)
data$SE_10 <- data$SE * (10 / data$Unit_increase)
data$HR_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10)
data$LowerCI_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10 - 1.96 * data$SE_10)
data$UpperCI_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10 + 1.96 * data$SE_10)

PM2.5_res <- rma(yi = logHR_10,sei = SE_10,data = data,method = "DL",slab = data$Study)

PM2.5_res <- PM2.5_res_sorted

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("p < 0.001")
  } else {
    return(paste0("p = ", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3)))
  }
}

svglite(file = file.path(figure_dir, "PM2.5All.svg"),width = 6,height = 9)
forest(PM2.5_res, at = log(c(0.5,1,1.5,2)), atransf = exp, header = c("Study","HR [95%CI]"), showweights = TRUE,
       xlab = "Hazard Ratio", mlab = paste0("Random effect model\nHeterogeneity: I² = ", round(PM2.5_res$I2, 2),"%, ",format_p(PM2.5_res$QEp)),
       xlim = c(-2.45,2),ylim = c(-3,length(PM2.5_res$yi)+3),lwd = 1.5, col = "maroon",border = "maroon",pch = 16, width = 2 ,shade = TRUE, colshade = "#EBEBEB",
       cex = 0.8, efac = 0.5)
text(x = 0.9,y = length(PM2.5_res$yi) + 2,labels = "Weight",font = 2, cex = 0.8)
invisible(dev.off())

###Based on the created figure, Kayyal-Tarabeia, 2024's study looks like an influential study.
###therefore, conduct the leave-one-out analysis to confirm

loo_df$HR <- round(exp(loo_df$estimate), 2)
loo_df$CI <- paste0("(", round(exp(loo_df$ci.lb), 2), ", ", round(exp(loo_df$ci.ub), 2), ")")

loo_df$Heterogeneity_Pvalue <- ifelse(loo_df$Qp<0.001,"<0.001",loo_df$Qp)

###So, for the main analysis, excluded this study (PM2.5-Main)
```

```{r}

data$SE_10 <- data$SE * (10 / data$Unit_increase)

data$UpperCI_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10 + 1.96 * data$SE_10)
```

```{r}
Numpost <- nrow(subset(data, data$Menopausal_status =="Postmenopause"))

  sub[order(sub$Weight), ]
}))

PM10_sub <- rma(yi = logHR_10,sei = SE_10,mods = ~Menopausal_status, data = data,method = "DL",slab = data$Study)

res.post <- rma(yi = logHR_10,sei = SE_10,subset = (Menopausal_status=="Postmenopause"),data = data,method = "DL",slab = data$Study)
```

## Figure 4C. Meta-analysis of hazard ratios (HR) and 95% confidence intervals (95% CI) per 10 ug/m3 increase in PM2.5 in relation to breast cancer incidence by study location
```{r}
#| label: Figure 4C. Meta-analysis of hazard ratios (HR) and 95% confidence intervals (95% CI) per 10 ug/m3 increase in PM2.5 in relation to breast cancer incidence by study location

data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = "PM2.5-Study_location + GS")

data$logHR <- log(data$Effect)
data$SE <- (log(data$Upper_CI) - log(data$Lower_CI)) / (2 * 1.96)
data$logHR_10 <- data$logHR * (10 / data$Unit_increase)
data$SE_10 <- data$SE * (10 / data$Unit_increase)
data$HR_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10)
data$LowerCI_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10 - 1.96 * data$SE_10)
data$UpperCI_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10 + 1.96 * data$SE_10)

data$Study_location <- factor(data$Study_location, levels = c("North America","Europe","Asia"))

Numeu <- nrow(subset(data, data$Study_location =="Europe"))
Numas <- nrow(subset(data, data$Study_location =="Asia"))

}))

res.eu <- rma(yi = logHR_10,sei = SE_10,subset = (Study_location=="Europe"),data = data,method = "DL",slab = data$Study)
res.as <- rma(yi = logHR_10,sei = SE_10,subset = (Study_location=="Asia"),data = data,method = "DL",slab = data$Study)
```

# Part V. Population attributable fraction for PM2.5
```{r}
#| label: PAF for PM2.5
## Assumptions: log-linear RR, exposure X ~ Normal(mu, sigma^2)

set.seed(20251027)

###***PM2.5***###
mu_PM2.5 <- 9.577           # population mean of PM2.5
sigma_PM2.5 <- 1.389          # population SD of PM2.5
xref_PM2.5 <- 5            # counterfactual PM2.5 (WHO AQG)
RR10_PM2.5 <- 1.08
CI10_PM2.5 <- c(1.04, 1.13)

## ---- Derive SE on log scale from CI ----
logRR10_PM2.5 <- log(RR10_PM2.5)
SE_logRR10_PM2.5  <- (log(CI10_PM2.5[2]) - log(CI10_PM2.5[1])) / (2 * 1.96)

## ---- Monte Carlo settings ----
B <- 10000  # number of draws

## ---- Draw effect (uncertainty from meta-analytic RR) ----
logRR10_draws_PM2.5 <- rnorm(B, mean = logRR10_PM2.5, sd = SE_logRR10_PM2.5)
beta_draws_PM2.5 <- logRR10_draws_PM2.5 / 10   # per 1 ug/m^3 slope

## ---- (A) Distribution-integrated PAF  ----
## E[RR(X)] = E[exp{beta*(X - xref)}] for X ~ N(mu, sigma^2)
## = exp( beta*(mu - xref) + 0.5 * beta^2 * sigma^2 )
E_RR_draws_PM2.5 <- exp(beta_draws_PM2.5 * (mu_PM2.5 - xref_PM2.5) + 0.5 * (beta_draws_PM2.5^2) * (sigma_PM2.5^2))
PAF_draws_PM2.5  <- (E_RR_draws_PM2.5 - 1) / E_RR_draws_PM2.5

PAF_point_PM2.5  <- mean(PAF_draws_PM2.5)  # Monte Carlo mean as point estimate
PAF_CI_PM2.5  <- quantile(PAF_draws_PM2.5, c(0.025, 0.975))

## ---- (B) Mean-only approximation (sensitivity) ----
RRpop_meanonly_draws_PM2.5 <- exp(beta_draws_PM2.5 * (mu_PM2.5 - xref_PM2.5))
PAF_meanonly_draws_PM2.5 <- (RRpop_meanonly_draws_PM2.5 - 1) / RRpop_meanonly_draws_PM2.5
PAF_meanonly_point_PM2.5 <- mean(PAF_meanonly_draws_PM2.5)
PAF_meanonly_CI_PM2.5 <- quantile(PAF_meanonly_draws_PM2.5, c(0.025, 0.975))

## ---- Print tidy results ----
as_percent <- function(x) sprintf('%.1f%%', 100 * x)

cat("=== Distribution-integrated PAF  ===\n")
cat("Point estimate: ", as_percent(PAF_point_PM2.5), "\n", sep = "")
cat("95% UI:         [", as_percent(PAF_CI_PM2.5[1]), ", ", as_percent(PAF_CI_PM2.5[2]), "]\n\n", sep = "")

cat("=== Mean-only approximation (sensitivity) ===\n")
cat("Point estimate: ", as_percent(PAF_meanonly_point_PM2.5), "\n", sep = "")
cat("95% UI:         [", as_percent(PAF_meanonly_CI_PM2.5[1]), ", ", as_percent(PAF_meanonly_CI_PM2.5[2]), "]\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
data$logHR_10 <- data$logHR * (10 / data$Unit_increase)
data$SE_10 <- data$SE * (10 / data$Unit_increase)
data$HR_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10)
data$LowerCI_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10 - 1.96 * data$SE_10)
data$UpperCI_10 <- exp(data$logHR_10 + 1.96 * data$SE_10)

PM2.5_res <- rma(yi = logHR_10,sei = SE_10,data = data,method = "DL",slab = data$Study)
data$weights <- weights(PM2.5_res)  #Extract weights
data_sorted <- data[order(-data$weights),]  #Sort data by descending weight
PM2.5_res_sorted <- rma(yi = logHR_10, sei = SE_10, data = data_sorted, method = "DL", slab = data_sorted$Study)  #Re-run meta-analysis with sorted data
PM2.5_res <- PM2.5_res_sorted

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("p < 0.001")
  } else {
    return(paste0("p = ", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3)))
  }
}

svglite(file = file.path(figure_dir, "PM2.5Allsensitivity.svg"),width = 6,height = 9)
forest(PM2.5_res, at = log(c(0.5,1,1.5,2)), atransf = exp, header = c("Study","HR [95%CI]"), showweights = TRUE,
       xlab = "Hazard Ratio", mlab = paste0("Random effect model\nHeterogeneity: I² = ", round(PM2.5_res$I2, 2),"%, ",format_p(PM2.5_res$QEp)),
       xlim = c(-2.45,2),ylim = c(-3,length(PM2.5_res$yi)+3),lwd = 1.5, col = "maroon",border = "maroon",pch = 16, width = 2 ,shade = TRUE, colshade = "#EBEBEB",
       cex = 0.8, efac = 0.5)
text(x = 0.9,y = length(PM2.5_res$yi) + 2,labels = "Weight",font = 2, cex = 0.8)
invisible(dev.off())

knitr::include_graphics("Figures/PM2.5Allsensitivity.svg")
```
